title: RiskMetric
description: One risk measurement about a pool, token or protocol: wash-trading probability, holder concentration, liquidity depth, impermanent loss, MEV exposure, contract risk. ABSENT TODAY: no table, no producer, no route. This is plan §32/§46 Group C. Every risk metric is DERIVED, so it MUST name its algorithm version and its inputs (plan §26) - a risk score without them is an unfalsifiable number and cannot be compared across releases. value is 0-100 by convention so one field type carries every risk kind; the meaning of 100 is per-risk_type and is stated in the description, not assumed.

subject_id.description: The pool, token or protocol the risk is about.

risk_type.description: Closed set. Each names one measurable thing; 'risk' alone is not a metric.

value.description: 0-100 where 100 is maximum risk for this risk_type. percentage.json is the right carrier because the scale is a percentage, not a ratio.

calculation_version.description: plan §26 metric_version/algorithm_version. Required: two releases' scores are not comparable without it.

inputs.description: plan §26 input_sources: what the calculation consumed, so the score can be re-derived.
